method: Local SHAP plus fleet-level causal evidence enrichment
local_predictive_evidence: Local SHAP values are aggregated to canonical HDD factors using sum of absolute SHAP for importance. Direction is determined from positive/negative absolute SHAP mass.
fleet_temporal_evidence: PCMCI stability evidence is inherited from the integrated fleet-level evidence matrix.
fleet_failure_risk_evidence: Matched incident ATT evidence is inherited from the integrated fleet-level evidence matrix.
important_limitation: Fleet-level causal evidence is not converted into an individual counterfactual causal claim. Local SHAP remains predictive attribution.
